title: English Practice Quiz 0197
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Which question asks for a reason?
I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: They ___ football every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb with the plural subject they in the present simple.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.
